<includeonly>{{#if:{{#switch:{{{external|}}}|yes|ja|1=1}}{{#switch:{{lc:{{padleft:|7|{{{target|}}}}}}}|http://=1}}{{#switch:{{lc:{{padleft:|8|{{{target|}}}}}}}|https://=1}}|<span class="plainlinks">[{{{target}}} <span class="bs-buttonlink cdx-button cdx-button--fake-button cdx-button--fake-button--enabled {{#switch:{{{format|}}}|blue|blau=cdx-button--action-progressive cdx-button--weight-primary|red|rot=cdx-button--action-destructive cdx-button--weight-primary}}">{{{label}}}</span>]</span>|[[{{{target}}}|<span class="bs-buttonlink cdx-button cdx-button--fake-button cdx-button--fake-button--enabled {{#switch:{{{format|}}}|blue|blau=cdx-button--action-progressive cdx-button--weight-primary|red|rot=cdx-button--action-destructive cdx-button--weight-primary}}">{{{label}}}</span>]]}}</includeonly><noinclude>
This template is used by the content droplet "Button". Changes to it affect every page that uses the droplet.

Parameters: target = page name or URL, label = text on the button, format = background color (blue, red or neutral), external = yes for external links that do not start with http:// or https://, e.g. mailto:. Links that start with http:// or https:// are detected automatically.

Inspired by https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Template:Clickable_button_2
